title: Boston Gas Company files for approval a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with Dexter Park Apartments.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: Boston Gas Company files response to the Attorney General's Information and Data Requests. By: Thomas P. O'Neil, Counsel of Boston Gas Company. (GC 00-10)
Attorney General's data and information requests. By: John M. Grugan, Assistant Attorney General. (GC 00-10)

The Department APPROVES the proposed Transportation Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms under the agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. (GC 00-10)
